description: Masses d'eau de transition - Métropole - Version Etat des Lieux 2013 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agence de l'eau Seine-Normandie. Une masse d'eau de transition est une partie distincte et significative des eaux de surface situées à proximité des embouchures de rivières ou de fleuves, qui sont partiellement salines en raison de leur proximité des eaux côtières mais qui restent fondamentalement influencées par des courants d’eau douce, constituant le découpage élémentaire des milieux aquatiques destinée ... Coverage: Agence de l'eau Seine-Normandie. The publisher named on the listing is Agence de l'eau Seine-Normandie. Its keywords include directive-cadre-eau, littoral, vedl, masse-deau, dce, observation-de-la-terre-et-environnement. The listing shows 5 download or service links in OGC:WMS, OGC:WFS, 0-HTTP--LINK. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
